label: B. Mariae Virginis a Rosario (Our Lady of the Rosary), Die 7 octobris

chants.notes: gr and al share one merged text block on p614 (y278.7-301.1); band given covers the merged block, do not subdivide.
p414 holds two alleluias (Post partum, Virgo m4; Felix es, sacra Virgo m8) - this is the latter, gregobase 481.

Index at p419 reads 'Ave, Maria... et benedictus' (disambiguator vs. plain 'Ave, Maria' at p630); kept the printed incipit from p614 as-is. p419 has a single of entry so it resolves correctly to gregobase 843.
Engraving spans pp. 614-615. Printed below it on p615: 'Ps. 44*, 2 ab. 10 b. 11. 12. 13. 14. 15. 16' - psalm-tone plan for this communion, not modeled.

Printed as 'CO. Ecce Virgo concipiet, 37, cum ps. 44*, ut supra.' - psalm-tone plan re-using the Ps. 44* verse list printed above; not modeled. ('ut supra' here is a psalm back-reference, not a Mass-inheritance rubric.)
